name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1862: His F-Sets tab read 116 of 135 while the console daily task force read 113 and its daily pick sentence read 112. Three numbers for one quantity on two screens, and two separate staleness bugs. The bridge signature that decides whether the console gets a fresh payload was written in v913 and never learned about the sets field added in v922, so a change in the set count alone left the console serving a fossil. Four of the six fields the console prints were missing from it. And the once-a-day pick sentence had a staleness check that covered runewords only, so it kept quoting a count he had moved past.
